# VENDOSOFT

> > VENDOSOFT is a Microsoft partner specializing in cost-efficient used software licenses, cloud solutions, and licensing consulting with up to 80% savings for enterprises across Europe.

VENDOSOFT offers a comprehensive platform for buying and selling second-hand Microsoft and Adobe software licenses, combined with professional cloud migration and hybrid infrastructure solutions. As a certified Microsoft Solutions Partner and Cloud Solution Provider, the company provides audit-proof compliance, buy-back guarantees, and expert licensing consulting to help enterprises optimize their software spending.

## Used Software Marketplace

- [Buy used software - cheap & legally compliant](https://www.vendosoft.eu/buy-used-software): Purchase legally compliant used software from Microsoft and Adobe with audit-proof documentation.
- [Sell used software at top conditions](https://www.vendosoft.eu/sell-used-software): Sell surplus Microsoft and Adobe licenses to VENDOSOFT with valuation and easy compliance process.
- [Second hand software - cost-efficient licensing](https://www.vendosoft.eu/buy-software): Buy/sell second-hand Microsoft and Adobe software licenses at competitive prices with buy-back guarantees.
- [Rebuy guarantee on new & used software](https://www.vendosoft.eu/buy-back-guarantee): VENDOSOFT buy-back guarantee: resell software within 3 years with fixed pricing and professional consultancy.
- [Used Software & Cloud Range](https://www.vendosoft.eu/range): VENDOSOFT's product range: used Microsoft and Adobe software plus cloud solutions up to 80% savings.
